name: @safebind/keyholder
description: SafeBind's key holder: the contract (GET /public-key, POST /unwrap, GET /health) and the open-source Cloudflare Worker a publisher deploys into their own account to hold the key their session evidence is wrapped to. The worker that seals imports only ./contract. The seal worker's tests also import ./holder, ./holderCore, ./sqliteTestStore and ./testWrap so its clients are exercised against the real holder in-process.
